name: 36756 · Marion, AL
findings: ZIP 36756 (Marion) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (56%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36756 (Marion) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 36756 (Marion) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
